text:
anna: quick thought — we should add an 'adaptive inspect' mode for routes so oncall can temporarily raise sampling for a problem route without blowing quotas. question: do we store pseudonymized request snapshots for sampled traces or only salted hashes? opinions?

mike: i like the idea of a UI toggle for oncall. two immediate concerns: 1) legal/reg compliance if we store even redacted snapshots, 2) cost impact (more tokens to S3/longterm store).

lina: for compliance, KMS + HSM-backed keying for any pseudonymization makes sense. store HMAC'd payload + small redacted snippet (e.g. first 200 chars) with TTL. that keeps debug value but reduces PII surface.

jasper: agree with lina. engineer perspective: if we only store hashes we lose context — very hard to reproduce request/response mismatches. hashes are fine for dedupe/metrics but not for debugging.

sam_prod: product angle — console UX should make it explicit what "adaptive inspect" does (sample rate, retention, who can toggle, audit trail). also we need a canary flow: toggle in dev first, then prod limited to SRE+eng leads.

anna: thanks. how about API contract? something like:
POST /admin/v1/routes/{route}/inspect
{
  "mode": "adaptive",            # adaptive | fixed | off
  "sample_rate": 0.05,            # fraction of requests to sample
  "store": "hmac+redacted",     # hmac+redacted | hash-only | full (disallowed)
  "retention_secs": 86400,        # TTL for snapshots
  "reason": "investigating 503 spike"
}

mike: API looks good. please add required fields: "audit_actor" and optional "expiry_override_ms" only for SRE breakglass. audit_actor must be enforced by authz.

lina: implementation detail — salted HMAC needs rotation plan. do not use per-tenant static salt in plaintext. use envelope keys from KMS and rotate monthly. store rotation metadata in the console so older snapshots can still be verified for audit.

jasper: telemetry: we should emit two metrics when toggle is used: `inspect.toggle.count{route,actor,mode}` and `inspect.sampled.tokens{route}` so cost shows up on the dashboard. also add a billing-alert hook if sampled tokens > X% of tenant budget.

sam_prod: for UX, make the toggle staged: small slider for sample_rate plus preset buttons: 0.5%, 5%, 20% and a prominent "Start session" button that records reason and actor. also a visible countdown TTL.

anna: question on storage shape — do we want one DB for metadata and object store for redacted snapshots? I prefer metadata in Postgres and snapshot blobs in S3 with server-side encryption + kms.

mike: yes Postgres for index/search (trace id, actor, ttl) and S3 for blobs. add an async scrubber job that re-scrubs text when we update redaction heuristics. important: scrubbed blobs must be immutable after write, and any re-scrub creates new blob with new pointer, old blob deleted when TTL expires.

lina: redaction heuristics — we should store original obfuscated locations basically token offsets so re-scrub can be deterministic. but that might be extra PII. alternative: run re-scrub at ingestion using latest heuristics and then never keep originals. tradeoff: re-scrub flexibility vs keeping raw. i vote never keep raw.

jasper: encryption + strict RBAC + audit logs buys us more latitude but legal still prefers minimal retention. product should offer two modes per tenant: "debug-friendly" (hmac+redacted snippet) and "strict-minimal" (hash-only + no snippet). default to strict-minimal.

sam_prod: agreed. default strict-minimal. provide tenant opt-in with a contract SBA for debug-friendly. UI should show the tenant opt-in state.

anna: ok next: quota enforcement. When adaptive inspect toggled we must ensure it doesn't allow unbounded sampling. ideas: budget bucket per-tenant for inspect tokens, with automatic cap and warning. when cap near exhausted the console should disable further toggles and emit alert.

mike: implement token-bucket per-tenant labeled `inspect_budget`. cost model: sampled_token_cost = model_cost_per_token * tokens_in_snapshot * sample_weight. use existing billing compute, link to tenant billing account.

lina: also add a per-route "emergency allowance" that SREs can spend (breakglass). tracked in ledger and requires audit justification. auto-expire after 24h unless extended.

jasper: oncall flow: when SRE toggles, we attach a `trace_note` with the action and create ephemeral debug workspace with limited retention. also a console view for recent toggles and who toggled them.

sam_prod: one more UX ask — add a preview screen that simulates cost impact of chosen sample_rate for last 1h traffic (est. tokens, est. cost, est. retained objects). small chart. users can confirm before starting.

anna: dev questions for infra: is it ok to add a new trace-snapshot topic in the telemetry pipeline? we can tag snapshots with `sensitivity_level` and route through scrubbers before long-term store.

mike: yes create topic `inspect.snapshots` with mandatory pre-ingest scrubber. pipeline stages: 1) redact (fast heuristics), 2) hmac/tokenize per key, 3) store metadata. make scrubber idempotent.

lina: note: scrubber must support attachments and base64. also be careful with embeddings pipeline — if we store embeddings downstream we must avoid leaking prompt content. so embed compute should run on redacted text only.

jasper: small CLI example for ops to enable adaptive mode for route `chat.v1` for 5%:
ri-admin routes inspect enable --route chat.v1 --mode adaptive --rate 0.05 --store hmac+redacted --ttl 86400 --actor jasper
(should return audit id and expected token cost estimate).

sam_prod: ok action items: 1) anna write API PR + schema, 2) mike prototype pipeline topic + scrubber, 3) lina design KMS rotation + key management doc, 4) jasper build console toggle + cost preview mockups. i'll own product docs.

anna: thanks all. tagging debug-bot for a quick confirmation on retention TTLs.
debug-bot: reminder: retention cap enforced by policy service — max retention 30d for debug-friendly, 1d for strict-minimal. audit events emitted to `audit.events.inspect_toggle`.

mike: noted. i'll open infra task and link this thread. :thumbsup:

lina: one final note — ensure legal signs off on tenant opt-in wording. i'll loop them in.

sam_prod: perfect. closing loop in the doc. :white_check_mark:

anna: closing — i'll start the API PR now and ping when ready for design review.
